facts.fact: Kenya News Agency reports the NCCK's Dennis Bosire urging the government to fast-track the Artificial Intelligence Bill, 2026, with an AI Commissioner overseeing AI content labelling and human rights assessments, against AI-generated election misinformation.

Kenya News Agency reports an Artificial Intelligence Bill, 2026 that the NCCK's Dennis Bosire says the government should fast-track, and a Draft Kenya AI and Other Emerging Technologies Policy out for public comment until 4 August 2026.

The Ministry of Information, Communications and the Digital Economy, through the State Department for ICT, invited public comments on the Draft Kenya Artificial Intelligence and Other Emerging Technologies Policy before 4 August 2026.

KEN.note: No locally built AI model, dataset or compute stated.

facts.fact: Kenya News Agency quotes the NCCK's Dennis Bosire naming the Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes Act, 2018 as an existing law offering protections not fully equipped for generative AI risks.
Kenya News Agency quotes the NCCK's Dennis Bosire naming the Data Protection Act, 2019 as an existing law offering protections not fully equipped for generative AI risks.

KEN.note: Public comments on the draft policy were invited, but the article does not say they were taken online.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Information, Communications and the Digital Economy invited the public to comment on the Draft Kenya AI and Other Emerging Technologies Policy before 4 August 2026, and Cabinet Secretary William Kabogo urged Kenyans from all sectors to take part.
